any: You may pick any book you like.
Is there any milk left in the jug?
We do not have any bread for toast.
many: So many flowers grew in the garden!
I have too many toys to carry.
How many eggs are in the box?
clothes: Wash the dirty clothes in the machine.
Wet clothes dry on the line in the sun.
My school clothes are a jumper and trousers.
busy: Are you busy, or can you play with me?
The shop was busy with people on Saturday.
Bees are busy in the garden today.
again: I missed the ball, so I tried again.
We went to the seaside again this summer.
because: I wore my coat because it was cold.
I smiled because my friend gave me a sweet.
The grass is wet because it rained last night.
station: The train pulled into the station and stopped.
We bought our tickets at the station.
Is this the station where we get off the train?
action: Sharing your toys is a kind action.
What action can you do with your hands?
Hopping on one leg is a funny action.
lotion: We rubbed sun lotion on our noses at the beach.
Dry hands feel soft after some hand lotion.
Can you squeeze the lotion from the tube?
potion: The fairy sipped her magic potion and shrank.
Drink the potion and you will fly!
Which spell book tells how to brew a potion?
